openTomorrow: Yes, definitely! I want to see if Maya posts anything new and check out more fitness content. I'm really into following people and seeing what they're doing in their fitness journey.
secured: I think it means your account is protected and safe, like your data is secure. Maybe it's about privacy settings or making sure only certain people can see your activity.
freeze: I'm guessing it means you can pause or freeze your streak temporarily if you can't work out for a day or two, so you don't lose your progress completely.
selfReported: That probably means activities or workouts that you log yourself instead of having the app track them automatically. Like when you manually tell the app 'I did this workout today.'
best: Discovering the 'Show Up 7' challenge and seeing that Maya has a 1-day streak. It motivated me to start building my own streak and following her to stay accountable together.
worst: The interface feels a bit cluttered with all these different tabs and categories. I wish it was easier to just scroll through people's activities in one clean feed without having to click around so much.
tellFriend: Yes! I'd tell my friends 'This app is actually pretty cool if you want to stay motivated with fitness. You can follow people, see their progress, and it's not as judgmental as other apps. Plus the 'Show Up' challenge is lowkey addictive.'
